_doc: Single source of truth for the visual language. Colors carry MEANING: a concept gets the same color in every explainer, so the vocabulary compounds across projects. Use at most 4 semantic colors in any one frame. Web pages use two materials: PAPER (the page: readable things, prose, charts of published data) and GLASS (dark windows onto a model's interior, drawn with the neutral 'color' palette). Semantic colors have a 'hex' for glass/video and an 'ink' variant that stays legible on paper. After editing, run: uv run scripts/build_tokens.py

color._doc: Neutral palette for GLASS (dark model-interior windows on the web) and for Manim video.

page._doc: PAPER: the web page and anything readable on it. 'card' is a token card lying on paper; 'highlight' is the monitor's highlighter.

token.means: Visible text: prompts, outputs, chain-of-thought. Drawn as paper-like cards.

residual.means: Hidden states: residual stream, activations, latent reasoning.

feature.means: Interpretable directions: features, SAE latents, concept vectors.

overseer.means: Anything reading the model from outside: probes, lenses, oracles, monitors, auditors.

training.means: Optimization: gradients, fine-tuning, RL pressure, reward.

type._doc: sans/mono are used by Manim (fonts installed on the system). display and mono_web are web-only (Google Fonts).

motion._doc: Seconds. Slow enough to track, fast enough not to bore. Hold after every reveal.
